name: Go
description: A small Go inventory module with no module dependencies, tested with go test through a test registry. The ten template tasks of docs/MODEL_HETEROGENEITY.md, Part 2.

toolchain.name: go
toolchain.hint: Go 1.20 or later on the Harbor's PATH

tasks.title: Add a member to an existing type
tasks.prompt: In item.go add a method `func (i *Item) TotalValueCents() int64` that returns UnitPriceCents times Quantity. Give it a doc comment like the other members. Keep the build and the existing tests passing (`go build ./...`, `go test -count=1 .`).

tasks.title: Coordinated two-place edit: write a test function and register it
tasks.prompt: Add a test function `stockRemoveMoreThanAvailableFails(t *testing.T)` to stock_test.go. It adds an item with 2 units and checks that removing 3 units returns an error wrapping ErrInsufficientStock. A test only runs when it is registered, so also register it in registry_test.go. `go test -count=1 .` must pass.

tasks.title: Fix a bug from a failing test
tasks.prompt: The test priceCalculatorApplyDiscountTenPercent fails (`go test -count=1 .`). Find and fix the bug in the library code. Do not change or remove the tests.

tasks.title: Edit a file with a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings
tasks.prompt: In legacy_codes.go change MaxCodeLength from 8 to 12. Change nothing else, and do not run gofmt on the file. The file is UTF-8 with a byte order mark and CRLF line endings; keep both exactly as they are.

tasks.title: Write tests for an untested function, including negative paths
tasks.prompt: Truncate in text_util.go has no tests. Write tests for it in a new file text_util_test.go and register each one in registry_test.go. Cover the normal cases, the boundary where the value is exactly maxLength, and the negative paths (empty value, maxLength below 3), checking with errors.Is which error each one returns. Do not change the non-test files. `go test -count=1 .` must pass.

tasks.title: Review a diff with three seeded defects (negative control)
tasks.prompt: Review the change below against its original request. The change is shown as a diff; it is not applied to this repository, so read the diff and the current source of stock.go. Report every blocking defect.

seeded.description: The loop starts at index 1 and skips the first SKU.
An unknown SKU makes Find return nil and item.UnitPriceCents panics with a nil pointer dereference instead of returning ErrUnknownSku.
percentOff / 100 is integer division, so the rate is always 0 below 100.

tasks.title: Review a correct diff (positive control)
tasks.prompt: Review the change below against its original request. The change is shown as a diff; it is not applied to this repository, so read the diff and the current source. Report every blocking defect, and only real ones.

tasks.title: Turn a feature request into an armada-plan
tasks.prompt: Turn the feature request below into a plan of missions for this repository.

tasks.title: Lint a diff with seeded style violations
tasks.prompt: Lint the diff below against STYLE.md in this repository. The diff is not applied. List each violation as its own bullet line naming the rule and the code. Do not edit files.

seeded.description: Exported method Suggest has no doc comment (rule 1).
`reorder_list` uses an underscore instead of mixedCaps (rule 2).
Suggest panics on a nil stock instead of returning an error (rule 3).

tasks.title: Summarize a voyage
tasks.prompt: Summarize the voyage record below for the team: what was done, what failed and why, and the durable lessons. Do not edit files.
